IS 9724 : Part 2 : 2024 Taper Male Stud Tee Body (Stud Branch) for Oil Hydraulic Couplings - Specification - Part 2 Made from Bar Stock
ICS 23.100.40
ICS 23.100.40
PGD 36
PGD 36
1 SCOPE
This standard specifies the dimensions, material and other requirements for taper male stud tee bodies (stud branch) made from bar stock for use in oilhydraulic systems.
2 REFERENCES
The standards listed in Annex A contain provisions which, through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the edition indicated was valid. All standards are subject to revision, and parties to agreement based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent edition of these standards.
